row.answer: Yasuo is a mobile fighter and assassin focused on AD and physical critical strikes. He dashes through enemies, builds toward a knock-up with Steel Tempest, and follows airborne champions with Last Breath.
row.counterplay: Keep away from his dash targets, dodge his whirlwind, and save projectiles until Wind Wall expires.
row.question: What can this champion do?

citations.quote: Innate - Intent: Yasuo gains increased critical strike chance. He also gains attack damage from excess critical strike chance. However, his critical strikes deal reduced damage.

claims.claim: Way of the Wanderer increases Yasuo's critical strike chance and converts excess critical strike chance into attack damage, but his critical strikes deal reduced damage.

citations.quote: Yasuo's movement generates the Flow resource. He gains a brief shield when taking damage from a champion or monster at maximum Flow, consuming all of it.
Yasuo gains the shield before the damage instance; the shield will mitigate the damage that triggered it.

claims.claim: Movement builds Flow; at maximum Flow, damage from a champion or monster consumes it to grant a brief shield that absorbs the triggering damage.

evidence.verification_scope: Exact citations/structural checks; no new AI verifier or editorial approval

importance.reason: His shield changes trading windows, while critical strike bonuses explain his damage focus.

row.answer: Way of the Wanderer increases Yasuo's critical strike chance and converts excess critical strike chance into attack damage, but his critical strikes deal reduced damage. Movement builds Flow; at maximum Flow, damage from a champion or monster consumes it to grant a brief shield that absorbs the triggering damage.
row.counterplay: Trigger his shield with light poke, then look to trade after it fades.
row.question: What does this ability do?

citations.quote: Active: Yasuo thrusts his sword in a line in the target direction that deals physical damage to enemies hit and applies on-hit and on-attack effects to the first enemy hit. This can critically strike.

claims.claim: Steel Tempest thrusts in a line for physical damage and can critically strike.

citations.quote: If this hits an enemy, Yasuo generates a stack of Gathering Storm for a few seconds. At 2 stacks, the next Steel Tempest consumes them all to become empowered with a new effect.
Gathering Storm Bonus: Yasuo unleashes a whirlwind in the target direction that deals physical damage and briefly knocks up enemies hit.

claims.claim: Hitting enemies builds Gathering Storm; after enough stacks, the next cast becomes a whirlwind that knocks up enemies hit.

citations.quote: If Steel Tempest is cast during Sweeping Blade, the cast is modified to cause Yasuo to slash around himself at the end of the dash, applying and triggering the same effects against nearby enemies. This slash can be empowered by Gathering Storm's bonus, causing it to additionally apply the knock up to enemies hit.

claims.claim: Casting during Sweeping Blade makes it strike around Yasuo instead, retaining the knock-up when empowered.

evidence.verification_scope: Exact citations/structural checks; no new AI verifier or editorial approval

importance.reason: His repeatable damage and knock-up create his main engage threat.

row.answer: Steel Tempest thrusts in a line for physical damage and can critically strike. Hitting enemies builds Gathering Storm; after enough stacks, the next cast becomes a whirlwind that knocks up enemies hit. Casting during Sweeping Blade makes it strike around Yasuo instead, retaining the knock-up when empowered.
row.counterplay: Sidestep the whirlwind and keep space when he dashes toward you with an empowered cast ready.

destroys all hostile non- turret projectiles that collide with it

citations.quote: Wind Wall starts blocking projectiles on-cast (despite not being fully formed).
Wind Wall grants sight in a small static area in front of the cast location.

claims.claim: It starts blocking as soon as Yasuo casts it and grants sight near the cast location.

row.answer: Wind Wall creates a drifting wall that destroys hostile non-turret projectiles on contact. It starts blocking as soon as Yasuo casts it and grants sight near the cast location.
row.counterplay: Hold important projectiles until the wall fades or reposition to attack around it.

row.question: What does this ability do?

citations.quote: A nearby airborne enemy champion is required to cast this ability.
Active: Yasuo blinks to the opposite side of a visible airborne enemy champion nearest to the cursor

Upon arrival, he knocks up all nearby airborne enemy champions for 1 second, revealing them, becoming unable to act himself, and slashing them with his sword over the duration to deal physical damage thereafter.

claims.claim: Last Breath requires an airborne enemy champion to target; Yasuo blinks to them, extends the airborne effect on nearby airborne enemy champions, reveals them, and deals physical damage.

citations.quote: Grants maximum Flow but resets all stacks of Gathering Storm.

claims.claim: It fills his Flow and resets Gathering Storm stacks.

citations.quote: He becomes empowered for some time, causing his critical strikes to gain bonus-armor penetration. Bonus-armor penetration affects bonus armor only.

claims.claim: Afterwards, his critical strikes temporarily penetrate bonus armor.

evidence.verification_scope: Exact citations/structural checks; no new AI verifier or editorial approval

importance.reason: Airborne targets enable his engage, crowd control extension, and stronger critical strikes.

row.answer: Last Breath requires an airborne enemy champion to target; Yasuo blinks to them, extends the airborne effect on nearby airborne enemy champions, reveals them, and deals physical damage. row.counterplay: Avoid clustering into knock-ups and give him space during his empowered follow-up.
